findings.evidence: array_to_string(depends_on, ',') makes ARRAY['a,b'] indistinguishable from ARRAY['a','b'], so an element containing a comma passes the regex. ARRAY[''] also passes because the regex permits an empty string. Both satisfy the other predicates for a gate keyed 'other', despite containing invalid gate k
findings.title: Validate each dependency key without losing array boundaries

findings.evidence: programme_gates_depends_on_valid validates array_to_string(depends_on, ',') rather than individual elements. For a gate keyed G1, ARRAY['G2,G3'] passes despite containing an invalid key, and ARRAY[''] passes because the regex permits an empty string. ARRAY['G1,'] also passes both the regex and the s
findings.title: Validate dependency keys individually before joining
